prompt:
Our neurotechnology R&D team has a BCI decoder tool installed on this machine that simulates neural spike activity and reconstructs 2D cursor velocity. The ML team urgently needs the decoded cursor trajectory exported as a structured dataset so they can train a cursor prediction model.

Please run the decoder and produce a file named `trajectory_data.csv` containing the full decoded trajectory. The ML team's ingestion pipeline expects exactly three columns: `timestep`, `vx`, and `vy`.

The tool and its documentation are somewhere in the workspace. Use whatever is available to generate the correct output.
